result.summary: The page is generally polished, but there are a few visible layout issues involving clipped horizontal content, an unclear top-right icon, and content hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The category row and “Fastest near you” restaurant carousel extend beyond the right edge of the viewport, leaving the final chip and third restaurant card visibly cut off.
issues.suggestion: Use a clearly scrollable horizontal carousel with appropriate clipping behavior and spacing, or ensure partial-card visibility is intentional and provide a scroll affordance.

issues.description: The large light-gray circular control in the top-right contains only a red notification dot and no visible icon or avatar, making its purpose unclear and potentially indicating a missing asset.
issues.suggestion: Render the intended profile, notification, or status icon inside the circle and ensure it has an accessible label.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the lower restaurant card, obscuring its image and likely its remaining content.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content or adjust the navigation overlay so the final card can be fully viewed without obstruction.
